column3: I hope so. Layana's been\nholding herself together\nfor everyone else's sake.{end_wait}
You might have said yes.\nShe needed to hear\nsomething kind.{end_wait}
Don't say that! Lady Layana\nalready has enough to worry\nabout.{end_wait}
You're right. I shouldn't\nhave spoken as though he\nwasn't coming home.{end_wait}
But knowing Hammet is alive\nand unharmed means more\nthan you realize.{end_wait}
Thank you, {actor_name:1}.\nPlease, don't risk going\nback into Lunpa.{end_wait}
You still have your own\nquest. Don't abandon it for\nour sake.{end_wait}
